body: Physical capacity is now adequate for Docker/buildx/model/native work, but Docker Desktop's server endpoint remains nonresponsive. buildx v0.35.0 is installed and callable. Treat Docker repair as runtime-health work, not another disk-reclaim cycle. Remaining classified GC inventory is only about 0.004 GiB, so repeated sweeps should enter yield-exhausted backoff until state changes.
subject: Capacity funded; Docker endpoint health is the next boundary
